exposure: Interval between screening and diagnostic tests: ≤ 7 days, 8 to 14 days, and > 14 days
interval between screening and diagnosis of gestational diabetes mellitus
Interval between screening and diagnosis of gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM)
cohort: 565 singleton pregnancies complicated by GDM at a single tertiary center from 2007 to 2013
finding: Increasing time interval between screening and diagnosis of GDM did not negatively affect maternal or perinatal outcomes.
